preregistration_status: Local prospective protocol before freezing inputs and before any new forward/loss/backward/update. Not externally timestamped or a blind study.
prior_knowledge: Historical full-Wine ATen intervention showed differences on Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C.
Previous hand-authored 16x3 fixed-logits fixture produced no differences on AMD EPYC 9V74. Current host sensitivity is unknown.
Host must be measured for this run; neither result establishes a historical CI cause.

fixture_recipe.normalization: Once under A: training-only mean and population std, zero scale to 1; freeze normalized tensor bytes. Never repeat preprocessing under each intervention.
fixture_recipe.batch: First batch of 16 from DataLoader(TensorDataset(train_x,train_y,row_ids), shuffle=True, num_workers=0, drop_last=False, generator seed42). Selection before any model outputs.
fixture_recipe.initialization: Local torch.Generator seed42; uniform[-1/sqrt(fan_in),+1/sqrt(fan_in)] float64 weights, zero biases; same layer draw order as existing Wine mlp16; freeze before forward.
fixture_recipe.storage: JSON retains full float64 values plus canonical big-endian tensor byte SHA256; fixture file byte SHA256 pinned in separate freeze manifest before capture.
fixture_recipe.no_search: No alternative fixture, architecture, seed, batch size, learning rate, or tolerance search after outputs.

compute.optimizer_initial_state: empty; first momentum buffer is adjusted gradient, not mu*gradient. Pin single-tensor public optimizer options. No full fit, validation or test evaluation.

hypothesis: On this host and fixed training-step fixture, effective ATen capability may change at least one captured float64 boundary. Null/negative outcomes remain valid and will be retained.

comparison.strict: Full scientific canonical SHA256 and each tensor byte SHA256; no rounding
comparison.numeric: All 19 floating stages <=8 adjacent finite binary64 steps, signed zeros equal numerically but distinct strictly, no absolute floor
comparison.exact: schema, order, names, shapes,dtypes,input/weight bytes,protocol and all nonintervention controls
comparison.failure_policy: Report strict and numeric failures independently of capture validity; never relax 8 after seeing outputs. Same-condition repeats must remain strict.

controls: fixture file and input tensors match frozen byte hashes
same host/affinity/runtime and normalized build config; requested A/B values are separately recorded
observed capability differs between A and B
empty optimizer state before one update; four momentum buffers afterward
checks: fixed schema/shapes/types/finite values and hash validation
analytic gradient/first-step SGD sanity tests; not the cross-condition comparison oracle
changed input, tampered hash, stage reorder rejection
same-condition drift and ineffective intervention rejection
real CLI no-overwrite/invalid timeout and partial worker failure retention
focused pytest, Ruff, compileall; no new dependencies
limits: No general bound, performance claim, historical cause, convergence or model quality claim.
First unequal boundary localizes this recorded dependency graph, not a native microkernel or hidden fused internal operation.
ATen capability does not fully control BLAS/MKL dispatch; record environment but do not infer those microkernels.
Frozen preprocessing and RNG remove those paths from the intervention. One first step cannot expose all later training differences.
Standalone local preparation only. Prior staged increment and its publication approval are not modified or bypassed. Package integration, full suite and exact-commit remote CI remain later work.
